name: The client reporting dashboard: Opal-shape reporting gold with total return on a conservative GIPS methodology, a precomputed served series per account, and the dashboard views that read it
description: One product read from two sides. BACKEND (workstream B): eight account-grain gold tables in ONE Opal shape for every firm (49 Financial first, then Inflection and Cottonwood through adapters), a schema contract per table, total return on a conservative GIPS methodology (daily valuation, end-of-day external flows as a weighting input, income on cash receipt, gross of advisory fees and labelled so, a fee rail reserved and unused), a guard that stops a misdated flow from reading as a huge gain, and a platinum publisher that writes one gzipped series file per account so any window is answered in the browser with no server work. FRONTEND (workstream F): the Performance chart with custom bookends and the honest label, asset-class performance and allocation change, realized and unrealized gain with the activity summary, transactions, the topic snapshot at the deepest drawdown (the signature view), household and client as the same page over more accounts, and plain-English coverage states. Net worth, held-away accounts and liabilities are out (Andrew). FWD-1 is one advisor's one 49 Financial account end to end in about two seconds.
